item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 29/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the persistent influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine and dry over Guangdong today and tomorrow. It will be cool in the morning. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over inland areas. The monsoon is expected to moderate over the weekend. With an easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong, temperatures will rise slightly and the weather will be mainly fine over the region early to midweek next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week.
